/* Force the cards container to always be a 4-column grid on desktop */
section.faculty-featured__section .faculty-cards {
  display: grid !important;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important; /* 4 fixed columns */
  gap: 20px !important; /* adjust if your theme uses a different spacing */
  align-items: stretch;
}

/* Each card stacks its content vertically */
section.faculty-featured__section .faculty-cards .faculty-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  min-width: 0; /* prevent text overflow */
}

/* --- PHOTO SIZING --- */
/* Your <picture> has class "four-to-five": make it 4:5 portrait (common for faculty) */
section.faculty-featured__section .faculty-cards .faculty-card picture.four-to-five {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 4 / 5;         /* change to 1/1 if you prefer square */
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #f5f5f5;         /* neutral bg behind image */
  border-radius: 6px;          /* optional */
  display: block;
}

/* Make the image fill the box without distortion */
section.faculty-featured__section .faculty-cards .faculty-card picture.four-to-five > img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;           /* crop to fill */
  display: block;
}

/* --- RESPONSIVE BREAKPOINTS --- */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
  section.faculty-featured__section .faculty-cards {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 768px) {
  section.faculty-featured__section .faculty-cards {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)) !important;
  }
}
@media (max-width: 480px) {
  section.faculty-featured__section .faculty-cards {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
  }
}
